"''How? How's that possible? It was… It was sealed on the Imperial Naval Base in Steergard.|Cassian Andor and Luthen Rael|}} '''Steergard''' was an astronomical object in the [[Expansion Region]]'s [[Woostri sector]] that was the site of the one of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Steergard Naval Yard|naval bases]]. Some of Steergard's Imperial technology was stolen by [[Thief|thieves]] who interacted with the rebel agent [[Luthen Rael]] and his shadowy [[Axis network|anti-Imperial network]]. [[Dedra Meero]], a [[ISB Supervisor|supervisor]] in the Empire's [[Imperial Security Bureau]], had jurisdiction over Steergard's [[sector]] and began investigating a link with one of the thefts at the [[Imperial Navy|naval]] base and similar thefts of Imperial technology elsewhere. After his capture by the Empire, a [[Unidentified rebel pilot (Anto Kreegyr)|rebel pilot]] associated with the [[Neo-Separatist Coalition|Neo-Separatist]] [[Anto Kreegyr]] was held in custody on a [[destroyer]] off of Steergard, where the [[torture]] specialist [[Doctor]] [[Gorst]] was sent to help interrogate him for Meero. In [[4 BBY]], a group of personnel training on Steergard were due to be transferred elsewhere. In [[3 BBY]], Rael collected the rebel [[spy]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] from [[Port Steergard]] on Steergard. ==Description== [[File:Steergard-GalaxyMap.png|thumb|left|300px|Steergard lay along the Rimma Trade Route.]] Steergard was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the [[Steergard system]] of the [[Woostri sector]], within the [[Expansion Region]] and [[Trailing Sectors]] regions. Situated at the coordinates M-16 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]], Steergard lay along the [[Rimma Trade Route]] [[super-hyperroute]]{{BuildFalconCite|48|Guide to the Galaxy}} between the [[Woostri system|Woostri]][[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] and [[Vondarc system]]s. Steergard featured [[ocean]]s. ==History== ===To steal from the Empire=== {{Quote|This is an Imperial Starpath unit. It was stolen from the Steergard Naval yard last year. We don't know when it was taken because Steergard was afraid to disclose its theft and thought they could hide its absence. My full report highlights the prevelance of this problem galaxy-wide.|Dedra Meero, to [[Colonel]] [[Wullf Yularen]]|{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}}}} [[File:HowdYouDoIt-Reckoning.png|thumb|right|300px|Cassian Andor met with Luthen Rael to sell the N-S9 Starpath Unit from Steergard.]] During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], an [[Steergard Naval Yard|Imperial Naval Base]] operated in Steergard, holding valuable Imperial technology. The Empire trained [[Imperial Navy|naval]] personnel there as well. By [[5 BBY]],{{AndorDate|103}} there were multiple thefts of Imperial technology from Steergard, one in which three of its [[targeting deflector]]s were taken and eventually fell into the hands of [[Luthen Rael]], the coordinator of a shadowy [[Axis network|anti-Imperial network]]. Additionally, around [[6 BBY]],{{AndorDate|108}} In the episode, [[Dedra Meero]] states that an [[Imperial N-S9 Starpath Unit]] was [[Thief|stolen]] from the [[Steergard Naval Yard]] "last [[Standard year|year]]," placing the theft around [[6 BBY]]. the [[thief]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] infiltrated the naval base dressed in Imperial [[Clothing|uniform]] and carrying a [[Tool kit|toolkit]], successfully stealing an [[Imperial N-S9 Starpath Unit]] sealed there without difficulty. After discovering the Starpath unit was gone, the Imperials at Steergard attempted to cover up the theft, afraid of the consequences of its disclosure. Nevertheless, the disappearance came to the attention of [[Dedra Meero]], a [[ISB Supervisor|supervisor]] in the Empire's [[Imperial Security Bureau]] who oversaw Steergard's [[sector]].{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} Andor attempted to sell the stolen Imperial Starpath unit to Rael in 5 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], but the pair were interrupted when the [[Pre-Mor Authority Security Forces]] tried to [[Ambush on Ferrix|apprehend]] the thief over a different crime. The Starpath unit was left at the scene and recovered by the Empire, soon catching the attention of Meero. The supervisor was able to investigate the matter further under suspicions of the existence of Rael's network, trying to link it with thefts at locations like [[Kessel]], [[Fondor]], [[Jakku]], and [[Base Cay]].{{Andor|The Axe Forgets}} ===Information gathering=== {{Quote|And where are you stationed?''"
"''I've been training on Steergard, but we're all being transferred now.''"
"''Really? Where's everyone going?|Luthen Rael speaks to a young naval cadet|}} [[File:LuthenVeryInterested-OYL.png|thumb|left|330px|Luthen Rael speaks with a cadet who is being transferred from Steergard.]] Later in 5 BBY,{{AndorDate|108}} a [[Unidentified rebel pilot (Anto Kreegyr)|rebel pilot]] affiliated with a [[Anto Kreegyr's group|rebel cell]] led by the [[Neo-Separatist Coalition|Neo-Separatist]] [[Anto Kreegyr]] was detained at a customs check and held in [[Prison|custody]] aboard a [[destroyer]] located off of Steergard. The [[torture]] specialist [[Doctor]] [[Gorst]] was sent there to interrogate the [[pilot]], with Meero asking questions remotely. Gorst got the rebel talking almost immediately for Meero, who extracted information from the [[prisoner]] about Kreegyr's upcoming plans for a [[Spellhaus attack|raid]].{{Andor|Nobody's Listening!}} In [[4 BBY]], a group of personnel being trained on Steergard were set to be transferred elsewhere. One of the [[Imperial cadet|cadets]] was the [[Unidentified naval son|son]] of a [[Unidentified naval father|naval veteran]]. At the [[Wedding of Stekan Sculdun and Leida Mothma|wedding]] of [[Chandrilan]]s [[Leida Mothma]] and [[Stekan Sculdun]], the naval [[Parent|father]] and son spoke to an undercover Rael, the son mentioning their training on Steergard. Rael continued the conversation by questioning where they were being transferred to next. In [[3 BBY]],{{AndorDate|206}} Rael sent Andor, who had become one of his [[Spy|spies]], to the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]] to assess the capabilities of the [[Ghorman Front]] rebel cell. The pair met again on Rael's [[Luthen Rael's Fondor Haulcraft|Fondor Haulcraft]] at [[Port Steergard]] on Steergard, Andor arriving late due to a spot inspection leaving Ghorman. The haulcraft departed Steergard upon Andor's late arrival. ==Inhabitants== Steergard was inhabited by numerous workers and Imperial personnel, including [[human]]s and [[blutopian]]s. ==Location== Steergard included the maritime industrial wasteland{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}} {{AD|Disney+}} [[Port Steergard]]. ==Behind the scenes== Steergard was first mentioned in "[[Reckoning (episode)|Reckoning]]," the third episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which aired on [[September 21]], [[2022]].{{InsiderCite|217|Star Wars: Andor Season One Companion|''Star Wars: Andor'' Season One Companion}} The scene where the location is mentioned was previewed in a clip released on the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] channel on [[August 24]] of that year.{{SWYouTube|N5S9Vx3-QM0|Steal from the Empire | Andor | Disney+|sw_url=video/official-clip-andor}} [[File:Spellhaus-Steergard-CLNE.png|thumb|right|300px|Steergard's placement in ''Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition'']] In "[[What a Festive Evening]]," the sixth episode of ''Andor''{{'s}} [[Andor Season 2|second season]] that released on [[April 29]], [[2025]],{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} the similarly named location Port Steergard appears but is labeled "Rimma Trade Route." This contradicted the placement given by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Emily Shkoukani]]'s reference book ''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'',''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' published on [[March 6]] of 2025{{DK|url=uk/book/9780241731673-star-wars-complete-locations-new-edition|text=Star Wars Complete Locations New Edition}} with map designs by [[Christopher Ibbitt]],{{EmailCite|email=File:AtlasEmail-2025-07-31.png|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2025-07-31}} as well as the [[Star Wars Galaxy Map|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map]] [[StarWars.com]] article and its accompanying appendix "[[Star Systems of the Galaxy]]"—both of these works having been authored by Jason Fry,{{Substack|subdomain=jasonfry|url=p/about-that-new-star-wars-galaxy-map|text=About That New Star Wars Galaxy Map…|name=[[Jason Fry]]|username=jasonfry|date=2025-06-24}} with the map design for "The ''Star Wars'' Galaxy" being done by Ibbitt,{{EmailCite|email=File:AtlasEmail-2025-07-31.png|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2025-07-31}} and published on [[June 24]], 2025. The second iteration of the "''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map" and "Star Systems of the Galaxy," updated on [[October 13]] of 2025, corrected Steergard's placement{{Substack|subdomain=jasonfry|url=p/star-wars-galaxy-map-update|text=Star Wars Galaxy Map Update|name=[[Jason Fry]]|username=jasonfry|date=2025-10-13}} to be along the Rimma Trade Route. This article therefore considers this correction to be true, and that Port Steergard is resultantly connected to it, which makes "What a Festive Evening" the first appearance of Steergard. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Reckoning (episode)}} {{Mo}} *{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} {{Mo}} *{{Andor|The Axe Forgets}} {{Mo}} *{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} {{Mo}} *{{Andor|Nobody's Listening!}} {{Mo}} *{{Andor|One Year Later}} {{Mo}} *{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|N5S9Vx3-QM0|Steal from the Empire | Andor | Disney+|sw_url=video/official-clip-andor}} {{1stm}} *[[Andor: A Disney+ Day Special Look|''Andor'': A Disney+ Day Special Look]] *''[[The Ultimate Star Wars Quiz Book]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' *{{StarWarsGalaxyMap}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Steergard |es=Steergard |ja=スティアガード |ka=სტირგარდი }} [[Category:Astronomical objects in the Expansion Region]] [[Category:Locations along the Rimma Trade Route]] [[Category:Terrestrial astronomical objects]] [[Category:Woostri sector locations]]
